fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM187,990. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0058663/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: Pass STPM/Matriculation/A-Level/Pre-University or equivalent, with at least a C (2.50 CGPA) in Biology/Physics and Chemistry, and Pass SPM with a Credit or equivalent in five (5) subjects including three (3) from among Biology, Physics, Mathematics, Chemistry, and English; OR Obtain a Diploma in a related field, with at least 2.75 CGPA, or if below 2.75 CGPA, must have at least 3 years (36 months) working experience in a relevant field; OR Other qualifications recognized as equivalent. English Requirement for International Students: IELTS 6.00 / TOEFL 550 or equivalent
